usage: agentware scaffold [-h] <subcommand> ...

positional arguments:
  <subcommand>
    new         emit a unit (module, verb, panel or loop lib) plus its verb
                declaration, manifest entry, mirrored test, doc row and parity
                row
    check       CI audit: every module has its manifest entry, owning test,
                doc row and parity row (exit 1 on any finding)

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
